facts.text: The hotel is set between Via Veneto and the gardens of Villa Borghese.
facts.excerpt: Set between Via Veneto and the beautiful gardens of Villa Borghese

facts.text: The hotel sits in the Via Veneto area, on a hill directly above the historic centre of Rome, with views over the gardens of Villa Borghese.
facts.excerpt: The Hotel Splendide Royal is situated in the Via Veneto area, on a hill directly above the historic centre of Rome with magnificent views out over the green gardens of Villa Borghese.

facts.text: The shops and designer boutiques of Piazza di Spagna and Via dei Condotti are a few steps away.
facts.excerpt: The exclusive shops and designer boutiques of Rome's fashion industry are just a few steps away in the legendary Piazza di Spagna and Via dei Condotti

facts.text: The hotel occupies a restored 19th-century patrician town house.
facts.excerpt: Occupying a finely restored patrician town house, dating back to the 19th century

facts.text: The 19th-century palace was once the headquarters of the Roman Maronite community.
facts.excerpt: After a skilled restoration of the 19th century palace and its interiors, the building that was once the headquarter of the Roman Maronite community

facts.text: The hotel is a converted 19th-century monastery.
facts.excerpt: is a converted 19th-century monastery

facts.text: The interiors display antique golden boiseries, rich brocade, polished marble and ornate stucco work.
facts.excerpt: offering a magnificent display of antique golden boiseries, rich brocade, highly polished marble, and ornate stucco work

facts.text: The main lobby has floors of Italian marble, a huge Murano glass chandelier and baroque wall decoration.
facts.excerpt: the floors cobbled with thefinest Italian marble, the huge Murano glass chandelier and the baroque decoration of the walls

facts.text: The baroque-inspired bedrooms and suites have damask drapes, crimson carpets, period furniture, and antique mirrors and artworks in gilded frames.
facts.excerpt: embellished with luxurious damask drapes, plush crimson carpets, period furniture and antique mirrors and artworks housed within impressive gilded frames

facts.text: Rooms and suites feature Carrara marble bathrooms, antique furnishings and double-pane glass windows.
facts.excerpt: feature Carrara marble bathrooms, antique furnishings, elegant fabrics and double-pane glass windows

facts.text: Almost all rooms have large marble bathrooms with natural light.
facts.excerpt: Almost all rooms have large marble bathrooms with a natural source of light.

facts.text: About one third of the rooms have large walk-out terraces, most facing the Borghese Gardens.
facts.excerpt: About one third of the rooms have large walk-out terraces, most of which face the beautiful Borghese Gardens.

facts.text: Some suites have a private terrace overlooking Villa Borghese.
facts.excerpt: some suites have a private terrace overlooking Villa Borghese

facts.text: The gourmet Mirabelle restaurant is on the 7th floor, with a view that takes in almost every monument of ancient Rome.
facts.excerpt: On the 7th floor of the Hotel Splendide Royal, and offering a vista which encompasses almost every monument within the ancient city of Rome, one finds the gourmet "Mirabelle" restaurant.

facts.text: Mirabelle serves Mediterranean cuisine and offers dining on an outside terrace overlooking the gardens.
facts.excerpt: The restaurant features Mediterranean cuisine and offers dining on an outside terrace with a splendid view of the gardens.

facts.text: A bar adjoins the restaurant.
facts.excerpt: There is a bar adjacent to the restaurant

facts.text: Three function rooms seat 10 to 50 participants, and a board room is located in the presidential suite.
facts.excerpt: Three function rooms, offering maximum comfort and the latest in meeting room technology have a seating capacity for 10 to 50 participants. An additional board room is located in the presidential suite.

facts.text: The hotel is a member of the Small Luxury Hotels of the World.
facts.excerpt: one of the members of the Small Luxury Hotels of the World

facts.text: The hotel is steps from Via Veneto and major works of art by Bernini and Borromini.
facts.excerpt: just steps away from Via Veneto and major works of art by artists the like of Bernini and Borromini

facts.text: The rooms evoke the boudoirs of the aristocracy.
facts.excerpt: The rooms are characterised by the luxury and spaciousness reminiscent of the elegant boudoirs of the aristocracy

contradictions.note: p1 says the 19th-century palace was the Roman Maronite community's headquarters; p3 calls it a converted 19th-century monastery
